prompt: When did the first Brazilian go to space?

options.text: In 2006, when Marcos Pontes flew to the International Space Station

explanation: Marcos Pontes lifted off from Baikonur on 29 March 2006, aboard a Soyuz.

prompt: Why was the flight called the Centenary Mission?

options.text: It honoured a hundred years since Santos Dumont flew the 14-Bis
